mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo, user_id AS userId, user_nickname AS userNickname, user_email AS userEmail, user_name AS userName, user_reg_date AS userRegDate FROM user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_id, user_password, user_nickname, user_email, user_name, user_birthday, user_gender, user_address, user_detail_address, user_zip_code, user_phone_number, user_reg_date, user_photo, user_role ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userNickname}, #{userEmail}, #{userName}, #{userBirthday}, #{userGender}, #{userAddress}, #{userDetailAddress}, #{userZipCode}, #{userPhoneNumber}, NOW(), #{userPhoto}, #{userRole} )
